```yaml
name: Harness Drift Report

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every Monday at 09:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 9 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: "Force run even if no changes detected"
        required: false
        default: "false"

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  drift-report:
    name: Generate Drift Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Drift Check
        id: drift
        run: |
          # Run the drift check script. 
          # Assuming the script exits 0 on success (no new drift) or non-zero on failure.
          # We capture the output to use in the report.
          npm run drift:check > drift-report.txt 2>&1 || true
          
          # Check if there are any tracked debt entries or new violations
          if grep -q "tracked-debt" drift-report.txt || grep -q "violation" drift-report.txt; then
            echo "has_drift=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_drift=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create or Update Drift Report Issue
        if: steps.drift.outputs.has_drift == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const reportContent = fs.readFileSync('drift-report.txt', 'utf8');
            
            const issueTitle = '📊 Weekly Harness Drift Report';
            const issueBody = `## Harness Drift Report
            
            **Generated:** ${new Date().toISOString()}
            
            ### Summary
            The automated drift check detected architectural debt or new violations.
            
            ### Details
            \`\`\`
            ${reportContent}
            \`\`\`
            
            ### Action Items
            - Review the tracked debt entries.
            - Address any new violations immediately.
            - Update the golden path documentation if the drift is intentional.
            
            ---
            *This issue is automatically generated by the Harness Drift Report workflow.*`;

            const issues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'harness-drift'
            });

            if (issues.data.length > 0) {
              // Update existing issue
              const existingIssue = issues.data[0];
              await github.rest.issues.update({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: existingIssue.number,
                body: issueBody
              });
              console.log(`Updated existing issue #${existingIssue.number}`);
            } else {
              // Create new issue
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title: issueTitle,
                body: issueBody,
                labels: ['harness-drift', 'maintenance']
              });
              console.log('Created new issue');
            }
```
